name: Clearbridge Health Limited
summary: Established in 2010 and headquartered in Singapore, Clearbridge Health Limited operates as an investment holding company, delivering diverse healthcare solutions globally, including in Singapore, the Philippines, Hong Kong, and Malaysia. The firm's activities are organized into three key divisions: Strategic Investments, Healthcare Systems, and Medical Clinics/Centres. Its extensive range of services encompasses advanced imaging diagnostics, such as general X-ray, CT scans (including dental cone beam), mammography, MRI, and ultrasound. Furthermore, Clearbridge offers general wellness screenings for conditions like diabetes, high blood pressure, and elevated cholesterol, alongside vaccination programs. Specialized care includes renal treatment, clinical services, aesthetic procedures, and dental and orthodontic services. Beyond patient care, the company provides consultancy to healthcare organizations and is involved in the wholesale supply of medicinal and pharmaceutical products.
